prerequisite: Run replace_alignment_geometry first to swap the centreline (length changes); use this node when the corridor regions still sit on the old station range
fixture_requirements: A single-baseline single-region corridor (the most common case)
A multi-region baseline corridor (verifies the three adjustment rules for first / last / middle regions)
One lengthened and one shortened alignment (verifies both extension and contraction)
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg
After syncing, the first region's StartStation == the alignment's StartingStation and the last region's EndStation == EndingStation
Middle region boundaries are only pulled into [start, end], never extended
Regions whose adjusted length would be zero are left alone with a warning; no throw and no deletion
Station write failures (read-only API etc.) go to warnings per region; the other regions are processed normally
A corridor without baselines throws and names the corridor; a Rebuild failure throws with the original message
Idempotent: on a second run regions_adjusted == 0
An unknown corridor name throws and names it
Results match the products\waterbox command C3DF-SyncCorridorRange(QZ) on the same drawing and parameters (same CorridorRangeCore)
